accept: Lessons: squeezing the air (piston) and keeping it from coming back (valve), as two lessons or one with two sub-functions. seal as a sub-function of the piston is acceptable.
The barrel, foot plate, hose and handle are givens. The pump head's clamp may be a given or a small lesson (lever, grip or catch).
The valve comes after the piston: its gap is that the air rushes back on the upstroke.
